@Test
public void testParsePositiveDuration() throws Exception {
    String str = "PT12345S";
    Duration duration = Duration.parse(str);
    assertEquals("PT12345S", duration.toString());
    assertEquals(12345, duration.getDays());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getHours());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getMinutes());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getSeconds());
    assertEquals(500, duration.getMillis());
}

@Test
public void testParseZeroDuration() throws Exception {
    String str = "PT0S";
    Duration duration = Duration.parse(str);
    assertEquals("PT0S", duration.toString());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getDays());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getHours());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getMinutes());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getSeconds());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getMillis());
}

@Test
public void testParseNegativeDuration() throws Exception {
    String str = "PT-12345S";
    Duration duration = Duration.parse(str);
    assertEquals("PT-12345S", duration.toString());
    assertEquals(-12345, duration.getDays());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getHours());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getMinutes());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getSeconds());
    assertEquals(-500, duration.getMillis());
}

@Test
public void testParseFractionalPositiveDuration() throws Exception {
    String str = "PT1.2345S";
    Duration duration = Duration.parse(str);
    assertEquals("PT1.2345S", duration.toString());
    assertEquals(1, duration.getDays());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getHours());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getMinutes());
    assertEquals(2345, duration.getSeconds());
    assertEquals(500, duration.getMillis());
}

@Test
public void testParseFractionalNegativeDuration() throws Exception {
    String str = "PT-1.2345S";
    Duration duration = Duration.parse(str);
    assertEquals("PT-1.2345S", duration.toString());
    assertEquals(-1, duration.getDays());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getHours());
    assertEquals(0, duration.getMinutes());
    assertEquals(-2345, duration.getSeconds());
    assertEquals(-500, duration.getMillis());
}
